section: verdict: sender-side deadline encoding audit and minimal observation prototype

identity.note: the planning-side historical commit is not in this repository; every source-level claim in this round rests on the current bytes, which are byte-identical to ROUND28's launch-time record

scene_block_correction.what: 1301000..1301015 is the ROUND22/24 development block, not a ROUND25 block, and it is not the block containing the reported failing scene 1400031 (which is in the ROUND25 evaluation block 1400000..1400063)

evidence.source_code: integrated_sar/comm_learning.py:113 computes clip(remaining_time / URGENCY_SCALE_STEPS=50, -1, 1) for the column named remaining_time_over_horizon; comm_learning.py:114 urgency_now uses a separate near-deadline threshold (25); no second scaling or normalisation exists between features() and the network (budget_masked.py:177-179, train_pilot.py:54-75)
evidence.source_and_units: integrated_sar/comm.py:819-820 remaining_time = registry snapshot deadline - clock.now (steps); snapshot via joint_driver.py:1058, clock via joint_driver.py:1072; deadline = detected_at + deadline_offset (comm.py:1146)
evidence.horizon_is_prerun_constant: EPISODE_HORIZON_STEPS=1000.0 (comm_learning.py:71) equals the run configuration steps=1000 (v2_common.py:110, r28_common.py:79); the horizon=summary['steps'] usages in old env wrappers are belief_age_accounting analysis metrics, not actor inputs
evidence.reconstruction_cross_validation: clock rule now = tape step - 1 verified on 197/197 candidate rows of scene 1400010; stored encoded features match clip(reconstructed_raw/50) on 102/102 points across the three sources
evidence.classification: naming inaccuracy plus a declared lossy scale; not an implementation that violates a contract

q2_new_encoding_preserves_differences.answer: yes, in the checkable sense of information preservation only

evidence.prototype: r29_encoding_prototype.py: candidate column remaining_time / configured_episode_horizon (1000), no extra truncation; exactly one column changed; 18 other columns and order unchanged by construction; urgency_now retained; horizon must be positive and finite; non-finite inputs raise
evidence.compatibility_rule_registered: same dimension does not make old checkpoints/optimizer states/replay buffers reusable: silent reuse must be refused; this round registers the interface requirement only and does not claim any production resume/eval entry point was modified or verified

tests.expected_values: hand-computed, not copied from the implementation

q3_do_differences_improve_learning_or_ta.answer: not proven this round; cannot be proven from this round's evidence
why: 0 environment launches, 0 training, 0 optimizer.step; the prototype was never attached to a network or an evaluator

no Δtask or Δcost was produced by the candidate encoding; the descriptive ROUND27/ROUND28 numbers tabulated alongside the audit are from the old encoding and old interventions, and carry no causal reading for the new column
whether the visible deadline differences are learnable or useful under the current task and budget structure is an empirical question only a paired from-scratch training ablation can answer

next_step_recommendation.status: recommendation only; no training authorisation implied; launch amounts to be approved separately
next_step_recommendation.what: paired from-initialisation training ablation: original encoding (comm-send-state/1) vs the single-column candidate encoding (comm-send-state/1r29-deadline-over-horizon)
rules: each arm starts from Controller(training_seed) with no warm start (and per the registered compatibility rule, no silent reuse of /1 checkpoints under the new semantics)
register beforehand whether urgency_now is retained as-is; changing it is a second, separately justified edit, not a side effect
scene blocks, seed discipline and ledger counting follow the existing experiment protocol; old artefacts stay untouched
a positive or negative result in one pair of arms is a mechanism datapoint, not a deployment decision

stop: local commit and stop: no training, no sampling expansion, no further interventions, no threshold tuning, no deployment, no automatic push
